prose: A HN poster reports that using Muse.ai to generate and 'improve' Facebook Marketplace ads got their Marketplace account suspended, quoting the suspension notice. A small but telling consumer-agent cautionary tale: platform abuse detectors do not distinguish assistance from spam.
highlights: User: Muse.ai-generated Marketplace ads led to account suspension
Platform message cited in the post
Cautionary tale for consumer agent use on third-party platforms
Summary based on the feed excerpt
